heading_en: Standards for Approval of the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 内部モデル方式の承認審査において、要件への適合を審査することを定める。
summary_en: Provides that the Commissioner examines conformity with the requirements of Article 250-6 through Article 251 and the following two Subsections.
paragraphs: When the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency intends to grant the approval under Article 250 for the use of the internal model approach, the Commissioner shall examine whether the requirements prescribed in Article 250-6 through Article 251 and in the following Subsection and Subsection 3 are satisfied.
